**Record** in the `Latiprimere.Rendering` namespace, from the [Latiprimere.Abstractions](/docs/reference/#latiprimereabstractions) package.

```csharp
public sealed record RasterRenderOptions
```

Describes how a band is rendered, beyond its size, pixel format and rotation.

Properties may be added in a later version, each with a default that keeps how pages render today, so code that passes these options keeps working. An [IRasterDocument](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/irasterdocument/) that can't honour a setting other than its default throws [NotSupportedException](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.notsupportedexception) rather than ignoring it.

## Constructors

```csharp
public RasterRenderOptions()
```

## Properties

### SmoothImages

```csharp
public bool SmoothImages { get; init; }
```

Gets a value indicating whether images are smoothed as they are scaled; `true` by default.

### SmoothLines

```csharp
public bool SmoothLines { get; init; }
```

Gets a value indicating whether the edges of lines and shapes are smoothed (anti-aliased); `true` by default.

Turn it off for barcodes and rules on a printer that prints only black dots, so that bars keep sharp edges and scan.

### SmoothText

```csharp
public bool SmoothText { get; init; }
```

Gets a value indicating whether the edges of text are smoothed (anti-aliased); `true` by default.

Turn it off for small type on a printer that prints only black dots, such as a 203 dpi thermal printer, where smoothed edges turn grey and blur when the band is made black and white.

## Fields

### Default

```csharp
public static readonly RasterRenderOptions Default
```

The options used when a caller specifies none: everything smoothed, as on screen.
